import sqlglot
from sqlglot import exp
for suffix in ['', ' ASC', ' DESC']:
    e = sqlglot.parse_one(f'CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id{suffix}))', read='sqlite')
    part = e.find(exp.PrimaryKey).expressions[0]
    print(repr(suffix), part.args, 'generated:', e.sql(dialect='sqlite'))
